phrases.text: This is this week's Fortnite Item Shop! The biggest bundles, every new drop, and every OG that came back.
Seven days of the shop, from November 3rd to November 9th, straight from Epic's own Item Shop data.
Let's get into it!
First, the biggest bundle of the week.
The Adventure Time Bundle! Finn, Jake, Princess Bubblegum, Marceline, and more. 13 items.
Listed at 10,300 V-Bucks, it sold for 3,800.
It was in the shop until November 6th, so if you missed it, it's gone for now.
Now, the new stuff. These all went live this week.
On November 6th, the A$AP Rocky Bundle dropped, with Helicopter Flacko and Rocky Rugahand.
13 items for 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 8,800. And it stays until December 6th.
On November 8th, more One Piece. The Straw Hats Bundle, with Roronoa Zoro and Sanji, for 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 4,900.
It's in the shop until December 5th, and the One Piece Bundle stays until December 5th too.
On November 4th, the KPop Demon Hunters Bundle. Rumi, Mira and Zoey of HUNTR/X, for 3,500 V-Bucks, listed at 7,200.
That one was in the shop until November 8th.
On November 7th, the Ben 10 Bundle, with Ben and Gwen Tennyson. 4,000 V-Bucks, listed at 6,700, until November 10th.
And today, the Star Wars Samurai Bundle. Darth Vader Samurai and Stormtrooper Samurai, 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 5,600.
If you're grabbing any of these, use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
A lot more bundles showed up during the week.
On November 7th, the Pumpkin King and Sally Bundle for 3,400, with a Jack Skellington Bundle for 2,600.
On November 6th, Lola Bunny and Daffy Duck, 3,200 V-Bucks for the pair.
On November 3rd, the Rambo Bundle, for 2,200 V-Bucks.
And the Champions of Mandalore Bundle, for 2,500 V-Bucks.
On November 7th, the Edward Scissorhands Bundle, for 2,500 V-Bucks.
And on November 8th, Deadpool Mashups, with Ravenpool and Cuddlepool, for 2,000 V-Bucks.
On November 5th, the Hospital Emergency Bundle, with Nurse Miyako and Nurse Hikari. 2,200 V-Bucks, listed at 5,000.
On November 7th, the Brainrot Bundle, for 2,400 V-Bucks.
And the Class President Nemia Bundle, for 1,800. That one stays until November 13th.
Add it all up, and 32 new bundles went live this week.
One more you might have missed. On November 6th, the Aerosol Assassins Bundle, with Komplex and Abstrakt.
2,500 V-Bucks, listed at 6,400, and it was in the shop until November 7th.
And a few more landed in today's shop.
The Golden King Bundle, with Ascendant Midas, for 2,500 V-Bucks.
The Orelia Bundle, for 2,200.
And the Cyber Infiltration Pack, with Chigusa, Megumi and Yuki, for 2,200 V-Bucks, listed at 3,600.
Now, the OG check. These Chapter 1 outfits all came back this week.
Infiltrator, from Chapter 1, Season 1. That's the oldest one this week.
Steelsight, from Season 3, and Abstrakt, from Season 4.
Dante, Rosa and Tender Defender, all from Season 6.
And Fishstick, Skully and Sparkplug, from Season 7.
A few big ones also left the shop this week.
The Ice King and Lemongrab Bundle was in the shop until November 6th, same as Adventure Time.
The Mariah Carey Bundle was in the shop until November 4th.
And the Guardians of the Globe Bundle, with Omni-Man, Invincible and Atom Eve, came in on November 5th for 2,800 V-Bucks and was in the shop until November 8th, same as KPop Demon Hunters.
And some are leaving soon. These are in the shop until tomorrow, November 10th.
The Ben 10 Bundle.
The Pumpkin King and Sally Bundle, and the Jack Skellington Bundle.
And the Edward Scissorhands Bundle. So if you want one of these, today's the day to decide.
Quick recap.
Biggest bundle: Adventure Time. Staying the longest: A$AP Rocky, the One Piece Bundle and the Straw Hats.
New today: Star Wars Samurai. And nine Chapter 1 OGs came back.
Which bundle did you grab this week? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
